notes.title: Milestone Winter Sale 2023
notes.content:
CLICK [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Milestone/sale/milestonewintersale2023]HERE[/url] TO VISIT THE MILESTONE WINTER SALE 2023 EVENT!

Winter is here... and Milestone is firing on all cylinders! Racing games are coming to (Steam)town!

If you want to ride motorcycles of the most acclaimed manufacturers, maybe even the one parked in your garage, the latest installment in the RIDE franchise is here for you. We're talking about RIDE 5: pure speed and no speeding tickets, we promise!

HOT WHEELS UNLEASHED™ 2 - Turbocharged is out: the world's raddest cars are back and taking the fun to the next level! If you thought the first chapter was awesome, well, buckle up because we are going to blow you away with incredible new features! 

The possibilities with Milestone are unlimited: saddle up a two-wheel beast and become the new MotoGP™ champion, and if dirt and mud are your thing, MXGP and Supercross are just one “Add to Cart” click away.

Last but not least... If that’s not your cup of tea, drive the fastest rally cars with our offroad titles such as Gravel and Sébastien Loeb Rally EVO.

One lap is all it takes to fall in love with racing!

notes.title: NEW PATCH RELEASED
notes.content:
Enjoy the Moto3™ class update on MotoGP™23! Also, thanks to your feedback, we have worked on the stuttering and disconnection issues in LiveGP events to improve your experience. Find out more below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056677/b023af475c02acab76e60f73cb04e45d7d54037c.png[/img]

[b]GAME CONTENT[/b]

Riders & Bikes of the Moto3™ has been updated to the latest changes of the current season.

[b]COMMUNITY FEEDBACK[/b]

Following your comments, we have worked a lot to improve game performances and reduce stuttering issues.
We also have investigated disconnection issues on the LiveGP events to improve the overall experience.

[b]ONLINE[/b]

Online matches: It’s now possible to see how many warnings & penalties has each opponent.
We’ve slightly changed the format of the events of the LiveGP. Now it’ll be possible to join events during all the planned time slot.

[b]CAREER[/b]

The Manufacturer Leader now changes according to the riders’ final championship position.
Added combined sessions screen during the P2 of Moto2™ & Moto3™.

[b]GAME INTERFACE[/b]

New curve indicators added on all circuits.
New Low Fuel indicator in the HUD.
